memo.title: Meridian Components — preliminary investment review (synthetic demo)

sections.heading: Business and revenue
sections.body: Meridian Components Ltd is a fictional precision-parts manufacturer. Revenue FY2025 was EUR 48.2m, up from EUR 41.7m in FY2024. The company employs 212 FTE. Management guides to flat volumes in FY2026.

sections.heading: Customer concentration and contract terms
sections.body: Its largest customer accounted for 18% of FY2025 revenue. The supply agreement runs to 31 December 2027, with pricing fixed to 30 June 2026 and a 90-day termination notice period thereafter. Customer concentration and the termination clause require commercial diligence.

sections.heading: Capital structure and covenant
sections.body: The board noted gross debt of EUR 18.5m and cash of EUR 3.2m at the FY2025 year end. The leverage covenant is set at a maximum of 3.0x. No dividend was declared. Derived leverage and headroom are reported separately by deterministic analysis.

gaps: The draft note's 24.5% EBITDA margin is unsupported and is excluded from the investment case. Use deterministic analysis for the calculated margin.
Audited statements, a quality-of-earnings review, and the detailed debt agreement have not been supplied.
Customer-level retention, order-book conversion, and evidence supporting management's outlook remain open diligence items.
Northwind screening findings belong to a separate synthetic company and are not evidence for Meridian.
